content_parts.title: Workflow automation

content_parts.content:
The Workflow logs page provides detailed information about your workflows. The main list displays all your workflows and basic information. 

Select a workflow from the main list to view:

  • A diagram shows your current workflow. Steps are color-coded so you can see at-a-glance which failed (red) and which succeed (green).
  • Log details provide specific information for each step, including error messages.
  • Variables used in the workflow are provided.

New workflow actions:

  • Order-to-order: create purchase orders and/or work orders from confirmed sales orders
  • Purchase requisition approval

content_parts.title: Improved document selection continued

content_parts.content:
There is enhanced efficiency and usability when you select Add lines from on:

  • Purchase orders
  • Purchase invoices
  • Purchase returns
  • Purchase credit memos
  • Sales shipments

content_parts.title: Purchasing price enhancements

content_parts.content:
You can use the Update price action to update the price, discount, and charges to match any corresponding price lists on:

  • Purchase requisition lines
  • Purchase order lines
  • Purchase receipt lines

content_parts.title: Purchase return approval management

content_parts.content: You can activate or deactivate purchasing approval for purchase returns at a site level. Once deactivated, you can confirm the purchase return so that you can post the document.

content_parts.title: Stock movements: Easy access to Stock journal inquiry

content_parts.content:
You can access a corresponding filtered version of the Stock journal inquiry from the following pages:

  • Sales shipment
  • Sales return receipt
  • Purchase receipt
  • Purchase return
  • Purchase invoice
  • Purchase credit memo
  • Stock receipt
  • Stock issue
  • Stock adjustment
  • Stock change
  • Stock count
  • Stock transfer receipt
  • Stock transfer shipment
  • Production receipt
  • Material issue

When there is a posting error and no stock journal entries exist, you can view the errors via the Stock posting error action, where available.

content_parts.title: Purchase invoice stuck at Posting in progress

content_parts.content: If the status of a purchase invoice status remains Posting in progress, but the related documents posted successfully, you can select the status pill in the header of the invoice to update the status to Posted.

content_parts.title: Sales invoices stuck at Posting in progress

content_parts.content: You can select the status of a sales invoice to resync the status to Posted.

content_parts.title: Contacts don't display when sending sales invoice

content_parts.content: When you send a sales invoice using the Select bill-to customer contact action, the contacts you can select are displayed.

content_parts.title: Purchase invoice doesn't update

content_parts.content: When you try to post a purchase invoice with an obsolete item, the purchase invoice status resets to Draft.

content_parts.title: Purchase receipt error when receiving site is stock managed

content_parts.content: You can create and approve a purchase receipt when the receiving site is stock managed only.

content_parts.title: Purchase order error when receiving site is stock managed

content_parts.content: You can approve or confirm a purchase order when the receiving site is stock managed only.

content_parts.title: Closed purchase order reopens

content_parts.content: When you close a purchase order and create a partial purchase receipt from it, and then create an invoice from that receipt, the purchase order remains closed.

content_parts.title: After allocation only 10 lines display in the grid

content_parts.content: You can view all grid lines on sales and stock pages after allocation.

content_parts.title: Allocation status remains in progress when header level allocation fails

content_parts.content: The allocation status on sales order lines are updated correctly.

content_parts.title: Revert button displays in error

content_parts.content: The Revert button is not available after you click on Post stock on the Sales shipment page.

content_parts.title: Sales order: Mass allocation remains in progress

content_parts.content: When you run several mass allocations in parallel, there is a control to ensure that a document line is only processed once.

content_parts.title: Error when creating a purchase order

content_parts.content: You can create a purchase order if the receiving site is different from the purchasing site.

content_parts.title: Error message when creating a sales shipment

content_parts.content: You can create a sales shipment from a sales order where one or more lines have been set to Closed.

content_parts.title: Searching MRP results doesn't return all records

content_parts.content: Searching MRP results returns all relevant records.

content_parts.title: Cannot create a purchase receipt from purchase order

content_parts.content: When you create a purchase receipt from a purchase order you can change the quantity.

content_parts.title: Sales order price origin defaults to base price

content_parts.content: The sales price defined for an item and a customer is applied in a sales order.

content_parts.title: No option to leave payment method blank on supplier record

content_parts.content: You can select None on the Payment method field.

content_parts.title: Sequence number on item, supplier, and customer categories not generated

content_parts.content: An ID is generated for a new customer, supplier, and item if the category selected is associated with a sequence number.

content_parts.title: Update tax incorrect details for purchasing and sales invoices

content_parts.content:
When a purchasing or sales invoice or credit memo cannot post or shows an error due to incorrect tax details, you can correct the tax info on the Notification history page. After you enter the correction, the overall document, as well as any line-item properties, are automatically recalculated as needed.

For purchasing documents, you can also manually enter adjusted amounts to align with the supplier invoice. Any changes are automatically allocated to one of the document lines.

This feature is only available if the Avalara integration is not active and if no open item was created.

content_parts.title: Find and view information more quickly

content_parts.content:
Updates to lookups and page header help you quickly find and select the right information with fewer clicks and less scrolling.

Better use of header space: Page headers with reference properties use all available space to display more data.

Improved lookup visibility in line entries: Reference lookups in line entry grids are larger so you can easily view and select the correct data.

Optimized lookup content: You can see more information at a glance.

content_parts.title: Consistent header layout

content_parts.content: To maintain consistency and improve scannability, when you open a record from another page, the record displays the same layout as when you access the record directly.

content_parts.title: Improved record selection

content_parts.content: There is enhanced efficiency and usability when you select multiple allergen records on the Items page.
